boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Michigan Tech spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, arts, and campus exploration.

cards.title: Memorial Union Building
cards.subtitle: 1503 Townsend Drive • student gathering and meeting space
cards.notes: Use the MUB as a practical meetup point before heading to a meeting, campus office, or dining stop; check posted room access before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A central building with student organization offices, meeting rooms, ballroom space, dining, and the bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech describes the Memorial Union Building as a student gathering space with dining, student organization offices, meeting rooms, ballroom space, and a bookstore.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Building (MUB) | Michigan Tech Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to building rules and event or room reservations.

cards.entity_name: J. R. Van Pelt and John and Ruanne Opie Library
cards.title: Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.subtitle: 1400 Townsend Drive • library services and study floors
cards.notes: Start on the first floor for research help or equipment services, then choose a floor that fits your work style and the library’s posted policies.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines service desks, computers, printers, collections, and designated study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The library map lists research help, express computers, printing, books, and multiple study-related spaces across its floors.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service information before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Van Pelt and Opie Library Silent Study
cards.title: Third-Floor Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library • designated silent-study area
cards.notes: Bring independent work to the third-floor silent-study area and keep conversations elsewhere so the room stays useful for focused reading.
cards.short_summary: A specifically designated silent-study space on the library’s third floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech’s library map identifies Silent study on the third floor of the Van Pelt and Opie Library.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Follow library quiet-area expectations and current building access rules.

cards.entity_name: Van Pelt and Opie Library Meditation Space
cards.title: Library Meditation Space
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library, third floor
cards.notes: When you need a short reset between classes, locate the third-floor meditation space and leave it ready for the next person to use.
cards.short_summary: A named meditation space within the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech’s library map lists a Meditation space on the third floor, and the Dean of Students directory identifies it as Library, third floor.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully and check current library access information.

cards.title: Experimental Education Environment (E3)
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library, second floor
cards.notes: If you are meeting classmates in the library, confirm the room’s availability or reservation rules before planning a group work session there.
cards.short_summary: A named experimental education space on the library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech’s library map lists the Experimental Education Environment (E3) on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Availability may depend on classes, programming, or reservations.

cards.title: Tech Trails
cards.subtitle: Across from the Student Development Complex • recreational forest trail system
cards.notes: Pick a route matched to the season and your equipment, then use official trail information before heading out for hiking, biking, or Nordic skiing.
cards.short_summary: A 500-acre campus recreational forest with trails used across seasons.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech says Tech Trails spans more than 500 acres and supports hiking, biking, and Nordic and cross-country skiing; part of the system is lighted in winter.
cards.access_notes: Check trail conditions, weather, daylight, and seasonal guidance before use.

cards.title: Student Development Complex
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation facility • near Tech Trails
cards.notes: Check the facility schedule before going, then choose an activity that fits the open spaces and any required membership, pass, or reservation.
cards.short_summary: Michigan Tech’s main recreation complex, with facilities for indoor activity and fitness.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech says the Student Development Complex includes recreation and fitness facilities such as an ice rink, climbing wall, dance studio, weight-training room, tennis courts, and pool.
cards.access_notes: Students access the SDC through student fees; other visitors may need memberships or daily passes.

cards.entity_name: Rozsa Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Rozsa Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: 1400 Townsend Drive • performances and event spaces
cards.notes: Browse the current calendar, then reserve a ticket or check student-ticket eligibility for a performance you want to attend with friends.
cards.short_summary: A campus performing-arts venue that hosts Rozsa, music, theatre, and other events.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that Rozsa, Michigan Tech Music, and Michigan Tech Theatre events are Pay As You’re Able, and eligible students can receive Student Rush tickets.
cards.access_notes: Ticket availability, prices, and student eligibility vary by event; verify the event listing before attending.

cards.title: Great Lakes Research Center
cards.subtitle: 100 Phoenix Drive • Innovation Shore research facility
cards.notes: Use the center’s public information and livestreams to connect coursework with the Keweenaw Waterway, and attend only programs open to visitors.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront research center supporting freshwater science, marine vehicles, and education outreach.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech says the Great Lakes Research Center houses teaching labs, a lake-level marine facility, deep-water docking, and research vessels on campus.
cards.access_notes: Laboratories and docks are research facilities; visit only through permitted public programs or access arrangements.

cards.title: Husky Plaza
cards.subtitle: Central Michigan Tech campus • outdoor plaza
cards.notes: Use the plaza as an easy outdoor rendezvous point between classes, and check the campus webcam or weather before making it your group’s meeting spot.
cards.short_summary: A named central-campus outdoor plaza with a Michigan Tech webcam view.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech identifies Husky Plaza as being in the center of campus and provides a Husky Plaza webcam among its current campus views.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions can change quickly; use normal pedestrian and event-area guidance.
